style.styleTitle: Lights4fun Oversized 2m Pre Lit Berry Christmas White Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Adorn your staircase with this pre lit oversized white berry garland! Bringing the outside in with a fresh and festive look, this garland is packed full of mixed faux foliage and finished with white berries and micro lights for a Christmas sparkle.</p><p>This garland is a generous 2m in length, offering plenty of foliage to wrap around your staircase to continue the festive flair through your home. Paired with 50 warm white LED micro lights evenly distributed along 4.9m of almost invisible green wire, they’re perfect for adding a cosy glow to your garland this season.</p><p>Simply dress your space, pop 3 x AA batteries into the battery box included, set the optional 6 hour timer and await illumination each evening. You can expect up to 100 hours of illumination before your batteries will need switching out.</p>
